status: read-only proposals; no active edits; no PDF build
mechanism: build_ledger.py invokes Pandoc --from=markdown+tex_math_single_backslash, retaining default inline_notes and superscript extensions. Pandoc parses bare ^[K:Q] as Note and un-delimited pairs of ^ as Superscript before layout.lua visits Str/Code/Math. It also parses adjacent [1+k(m−1)](k+1) mathematical factors as a hyperlink to k+1. Actual AST probes of all 12 Markdown files reproduce exactly two Notes, fifteen Superscripts and the two formula Links. Every proposed expression parses as a single InlineMath node.
